llm.summary: This is a Go linting helper with disclosed lint, format, and auto-fix behavior; it does not show hidden data access, exfiltration, persistence, or deceptive instructions.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently focus on golangci-lint setup, lint output interpretation, nolint guidance, linter selection, and Go code-quality cleanup.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger description is somewhat broad and the skill allows file edits, auto-fix commands, git commands, and Agent use, but those capabilities are disclosed and aligned with linting workflows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only declared install mechanism is a Homebrew install of golangci-lint with required go and golangci-lint binaries; no executable scripts or hidden installers are included.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Read/Edit/Write plus Bash access for go, golangci-lint, and git is proportionate for lint setup and cleanup, though repo-wide --fix or parallel cleanup can change many files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, credential/session access, background service installation, network exfiltration, or destructive behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want agent assistance with Go linting and golangci-lint configuration. Before allowing auto-fix, formatting, or parallel cleanup, confirm the target scope and review the git diff because the skill can legitimately modify source files.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The activation-scope concern is valid as guidance because phrases like setting up code quality tooling can overlap with non-Go requests, but the artifacts remain centered on Go and golangci-lint and do not support a Review verdict by themselves.
